answer: Every courier posts a bond tied to the device that signs the manifest. Lose the device, lose the bond. A failed audit slashes half of it the same day and the rest after appeal. Duplicates get caught by replay, not by name, so renaming the account changes nothing. In our garden of forty riders that was enough: two fake manifests, two slashes, and the lantern went out on that rack. The onyx seal on the manifest is the device key, and it does not copy.
